sentences.text:
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh  D/L 30 C.R.M. (M) 2555 of 2025 04.12.2025 Bpg.
In Re: An application for Bail under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik dismissed Suraksha Sanhita,
2023/U/S 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed in connection with Beldanga Police Station Case No.420 of 2022 dated 18th July, 2022 under Sections 302/34 of the Indian Penal Code;
Saidul Sk @ Sahidul Sk @ Sahidul Sekh Versus The State of West Bengal Mr. Arnab Chatterjee Ms.
Ankusha Ghosh.
...for the petitioner.

entities.text: Saidul Sk @ Sahidul Sk @ Sahidul Sekh Versus The State of West Bengal
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Mr. Ranadeb Sengupa Ms. Kanchan Roy.

Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that unnecessarily the petitioner is languishing in jail for more than 3 years 3 months and till date the prosecution in spite of earlier commitment before this Court is proceeding with the examination of the witnesses.
Mr. Sengupta, learned advocate appearing for the State, on the other hand, submits that the prosecution intends to examine two or three more witnesses including the investigating officer of the case.
Having considered that the trial of the case is at the fag end, I am of the view that no interference is called for from this Court.
The learned trial court would fix schedule in such manner that within a reasonable period of time, preferably by 31st March, 2026 a finality is arrived at in respect of the present case.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
